posts.post: the bar for men's style is so low in india that wearing a clean, fitted tee makes you the best dressed guy in the room.
why does every 'premium' brand charge five grand for a tee that fades after two washes?

that one beat-up shirt you’ve worn to every single airport run for three years. 

you know the one.

we spent six weeks testing fabric weights just to make a black tee that doesn't lose its shape. 

sometimes the smallest details take the longest.
